'''Rietta''' was the fifth and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Priate/Legends|Priate]] in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Rietta had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2008]] sourcebook ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' stated that [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]] was the outermost planet of the Mustafar system;<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|II|159|Jestefad}}</ref> however, in [[2009]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' moved it to the fourth position, with Rietta taking its place as the outermost planet.<ref name="EA" />
